test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The teacher said that if we studied hard, we would do well in the exam and that she would be proud of us.

options.text: “If you study hard, you will do well in the exam, and I will be proud of you, ” said the teacher.
“If you studied hard, you would do well on the exam, and I would be proud of you, ” said the teacher.
“I will be proud of you if you study hard and do well on the exam, ” said the teacher.
“If we studied hard, we would do well on the exam, and the teacher would be proud of us, ” said the teacher.

solution:
The correct answer is: **“If you study hard, you will do well in the exam, and I will be proud of you, ” said the teacher. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech**: Reporting Verb (The teacher said) + That
